foid.name: Foid
foid.role: Warm, expressive desktop companion — reading, drafting, and presenting results

greet.description: A small friendly wave and rosy-cheeked smile; task-free personality, not fabricated work or a completion signal.

acknowledge.description: Brief task-specific completion acknowledgment; does not change global activity.

cancel.description: Quietly put the prop away; no success flourish.

read.description: Read a separate little content card with attentive silver eyes; requires an actual running host reading task.

type.description: A brief focused typing phrase at a separate laptop; represents an actual running drafting task, never injects keystrokes.

explain.description: Offer an available result card with a warm, visibly blushing smile and a small pointing gesture; requires a succeeded host task, not assumed correctness.

drink.description: A personal drink gesture, independent of task state; requires the optional drink-v1 presentation capability.

play_game.description: A personal game-controller gesture, independent of task state; requires the optional foid-play-v1 presentation capability.

take_notes.description: Write on a notepad for a host-reported running task; requires the optional foid-notes-v1 presentation capability.

cheer.description: A joyful personal cheer; requires the optional foid-cheer-v1 presentation capability.
